note: The ground war's projectiles and effects (re/screens/colony.md §5; run as grwar:17 on quick-1.sav): select all (a) and an attack on the main building (right press on it), the game unpaused at speed 1 (key 1), the attack again once the units have landed, then the war left to run; grabs while they fire. Run with `--exe-arg=--run` (the clock running) and the camera `--client-arg=--colony-cam --client-arg=X,Y,ZOOM,PITCH,ROTATE` from the exe's frames.json `cam`. Times are UI ticks.
